Summary: Light in Scripture stands for God's truth, purity, guidance, and life, shining first at creation and finally in the face of Christ. Jesus, the Light of the World, exposes darkness, guides our steps, and calls His people the light of the world. Walking in the light means honest, joyful fellowship with God and one another.
KeyPassages: Genesis 1:3; Psalm 119:105; Isaiah 60:1; Matthew 5:14-16; John 8:12; 1 John 1:5-7
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Psalms; Isaiah; Matthew; John; 1 John
RelatedEvents: Creation; The Birth of Jesus; Transfiguration
